report.question: How do smooth geometry, measure regularity and quantitative correlations constrain Bernoulli structure, classical Gaussian limits and higher-order mixing?
report.reading_scope: Sections 1-5 in full, all displayed formulas, theorem and problem statements, footnotes 1-2, bibliography 1-64 and publication/license metadata. No official PDF or image visual audit claimed.
report.coverage_status: 55 atomic pages 3801-381J, narrative 3800 and one reference. All main official branches have entries; deep proofs remain explicitly cited. Open problems stay narrative instead of being mechanically split into theorem-like atoms.

proof_scope.3801: Defines smooth nonnegative density and distinguishes positive-density equivalence.
proof_scope.3802: Defines all-pair separation and the flow convention; gives bounded-observable equivalence by finite approximation.
proof_scope.3803: Proves lowering order and mixing-to-weak-mixing-to-ergodicity; cites Sinai for K to all orders.
proof_scope.3804: Retains exists r,C,rate before forall observables and times; constants may depend on order.
proof_scope.3805: Proves descending orders with a constant observable, retaining rate and norm constants.
proof_scope.3806: Defines shared normalization and permits degenerate individual variances; only variance functional nonzero.
proof_scope.3807: Separates C^r/C-infinity/analytic observable regularity from invariant measure; replaces removed duplicate Green-Kubo atom, reused as 330W.
proof_scope.3808: Shows bounded transfer coboundary normalized sums vanish uniformly; proves mean zero.
proof_scope.3809: Uses tightness, Birkhoff and L1 approximation of invariant indicators; no nonzero variance for each observable.
proof_scope.3810: Defines standard/loosely Kronecker in ergodic zero entropy class with positive L1 time change and measure reweighting.
proof_scope.3811: Defines nilpotent adjoint and chain depths rather than block sizes; computes sl2 and product examples.
proof_scope.3812: Restricts to ergodic nontrivial finite-volume linear semisimple setting; uses GR=3 and explicitly permits zero projections on additional factors.
proof_scope.3813: Cites Katok sufficient obstruction with pointwise positive smooth cocycle and ergodic zero-entropy fiber.
proof_scope.3814: Defines interval exchanges; complete finite-additivity proof of Lebesgue preservation and two-interval rotation calculation.
proof_scope.3815: Complete local suspension formula and derivative calculation; no mixing inferred from derivative alone.
proof_scope.3816: Complete power/log integrability calculation and finite suspension-volume deduction.
proof_scope.3817: Defines measurable flow towers and almost partitions; complete boundary-strip bound.
proof_scope.3818: Defines original almost-measure-preserving condition; independent safe 5-epsilon integral bound without an unstated proper-domain containment assumption.
proof_scope.3819: Full compact-metric LUS sufficient framework, preserving all three tower/shear clauses; normalizes k>=1 and integer grid endpoints.
proof_scope.380A: Cites CLT for Anosov times Diophantine rotation; fully checks the eigenfunction obstruction to weak mixing.
proof_scope.380B: Defines skew product and proves invariance and inverse by Fubini and action law.
proof_scope.380C: Proves iterate formula and additive cocycle identity, including signed n convention.
proof_scope.380D: Checks conjugacy sign and measure preservation; constant cocycle reduction.
proof_scope.380E: Defines exact Bernoulli product model and proves walk formula; K and non-Bernoulli are cited Kalikow inputs.
proof_scope.380F: Surface-only Pesin Bernoulli theorem; four-dimensional counterexample split to 381H and 3D question to outline.
proof_scope.380G: States compact C1+alpha smooth invariant probability theorem; describes proof inputs without claiming proof.
proof_scope.380H: Defines names and Hamming pseudometric and proves bounded-observable average estimate.
proof_scope.380I: Proves obstruction using a small positive-measure ball and compactness subsequence, not positive Lyapunov theorem.
proof_scope.380J: States K-conditioned homogeneous theorem; avoids claiming every nontrivial semisimple translation is K. Uses the standard connected finite-centre no-compact-factor linear semisimple subclass.
proof_scope.380K: Defines positive-exponent SRB convention and conditional densities; does not equate physical and SRB measures.
proof_scope.380L: Defines exact two-test estimate with noninvariant volume; derives invariance of limit.
proof_scope.380M: Maldonado A only, compact C1+alpha and invariant exponentially mixing SRB; B split to 381I.
proof_scope.380N: States per-observable possibly-degenerate CLT and distinguishes system-level nondegeneracy.
proof_scope.380O: Cites existence and proves nonmixing passes from a base factor; no general arbitrary-cocycle construction.
proof_scope.380P: Cites quantified analytic counterexamples at each polynomial rate; does not exchange forall m exists F with exists F forall m.
proof_scope.380Q: Preserves forall finite r exists M_r,F_r and zero topological entropy; explains no C-infinity diagonal conclusion.
proof_scope.380R: Cites analytic strengthening, C3 observable scope, zero metric versus positive topological entropy.
proof_scope.380S: Proves integral cocycle, flow law and invariance; regularity inherited only with smooth data.
proof_scope.380T: Records mean-zero S1, vector S2 with explicit fixed threshold and o(T^-5), and S3 required for nondegenerate variance.
proof_scope.380U: Derives integrated observable relation and non-surjectivity example using periodic rotation.
proof_scope.380V: Defines aperiodicity modulo constant and lattice; proves it is stronger than not being a coboundary.
proof_scope.380W: Gives exact A/B/C sequence and good-set quantifiers; does not replace quasi-ellipticity by vague sublinear growth.
proof_scope.380X: Specializes to hyperbolic toral Lebesgue base; restores ergodicity, zero entropy and regular generating partition.
proof_scope.380Y: Defines rotation suspension with integrable power roof and distinguishes smooth realizations from every abstract exponent.
proof_scope.380Z: Restores a.e. rotation, 0<gamma<1/2, convex C2 roof and zero-mean aperiodic cocycle; specializes base to toral Lebesgue.
proof_scope.381A: Explicit QLUS quantifiers and substitutions, including time-separation inequality and all three inherited clauses.
proof_scope.381B: Cites qualitative LUS upgrade; explains correlation averaging mechanism, not a proof of the induction or van der Corput estimate.
proof_scope.381C: Cites qualitative and polynomial versions for the same precisely specified roof model; no full shearing-partition proof.
proof_scope.381D: Independent derivative and orbit-sum calculation for an exact logarithmic model; no assertion that imbalance alone proves mixing.
proof_scope.381E: Cites compact special case of time-change theorem with full group/lattice hypotheses; proves reweighted invariant measure by generator integration.
proof_scope.381F: Independent matrix conjugation and compact-Riemannian error estimate proving the t^(1/4) shear example.
proof_scope.381G: Cites Bernoulli realization on compact connected smooth manifolds of dimension>=2; separates measure-theoretic existence from quantitative bounds.
proof_scope.381H: Cites existence on T4 only, not a universal claim for arbitrary Kochergin exponent or cocycle; gives dimension/product explanation.
proof_scope.381I: Cites compact C1+alpha non-atomic exponential volume limit theorem with m versus mu distinguished; no claimed mixing of limit measure.
proof_scope.381J: Cites quantitative upgrade with explicit product, embedding and polynomial pullback norm hypotheses; no proof of full quantitative induction.

remaining_branches: Full Ornstein-Weiss/VWB matching, Pesin constructions, homogeneous equidistribution, Maldonado's SRB box construction and Bernoulli proof remain external.

Official open Problems 5.1-5.9 are discussed by branch in 3800; no claimed resolution of dimension 3, general Rokhlin, exponential all-order rates, arbitrary-measure positive entropy, fixed-manifold smooth CLT or C-infinity zero-entropy diffeomorphism CLT.
normalization_notes: 3804 allows any invariant Borel probability; measure smoothness is only imposed by theorems that require it.
3801 measure regularity separated from 3807 observable regularity/norms.
The old draft Green-Kubo content at 3807 was removed and replaced by regularity definitions; all Green-Kubo reuse goes to 330W.
380B/380C uniformly allow additive groups R^d and Z^d; continuous flow is only the R case.
380F is the surface theorem; 381H is four-dimensional existence; dimension 3 remains in 3800.
380M is SRB exponential mixing; 381I is non-atomic exponential volume limit.
GR uses chain depth, not block size; entropy type, finite versus infinite smoothness, and flow versus map are retained.

source_errata.status: Two consecutive independent random variables do not define an iid process.
source_errata.handling: Use existing 00S3, which requires independence of every finite subfamily; no duplicate Bernoulli definition.

source_errata.status: Mixed n/N indexing and time-gap notation normalized.
source_errata.handling: 3802 uses all-pair separation; ordered times use adjacent minimum gaps equivalently.

source_errata.status: 'Positive answer in finite smoothness' conflicts with the displayed zero topological entropy counterexample.
source_errata.handling: 380Q and 3800 state the negative answer: for each finite regularity r an example exists. This is not one C-infinity example.

source_errata.status: Uncentered statement fails on the constant observable 1.
source_errata.handling: 380T follows Z2210v1 Definition 3 with mean-zero observables and convergence in distribution. The stronger L1 open-problem wording is not silently identified with this condition.

source_errata.status: Inconsistent psi/phi, R/T and little-o inside the defining event.
source_errata.handling: 380T uses a fixed centered vector cocycle tau, fixed C log^2(T) threshold, and probability o(T^-5), exactly the flow condition in Z2210v1. No guessed scalar diffeomorphism theorem is supplied.

source_errata.status: Compactness, C1+alpha regularity and the non-atomic limit-SRB qualification are absent from the abbreviated survey statement.
source_errata.handling: 381I restores all three from M2504v1 section 1.1/Theorem B; 380L separates m from mu. 380M contains only Theorem A.

source_errata.status: Abbreviated quasi-elliptic criterion omits zero entropy, ergodicity and regular generating partition.
source_errata.handling: 380W/380X use DK1912v1 Definitions 1.1-1.2 and Theorem 1.3; public theorem specialized to hyperbolic toral Lebesgue base.

source_errata.status: Frequency and roof regularity hypotheses are compressed.
source_errata.handling: 380Y/380Z retain almost-everywhere frequency, positive convex C2 singular roof, derivative asymptotes, zero mean and aperiodicity from N2601v1.

source_errata.status: Ergodicity and degenerate one-parameter projections require care.
source_errata.handling: 3812 uses the ergodic nontrivial formulation of KVW1805v2. A zero projection is allowed on an extra factor of an irreducible quotient; a product quotient can fail ergodicity.

source_errata.status: The introduction calls m_i block sizes although the formula uses chain depth.
source_errata.handling: 3811 sets m_i=Jordan block size minus one and checks sl2 gives GR=3 and two copies give GR=6.

source_errata.status: The survey wording is broader than KR2410v1 Theorems A-D as precisely formulated.
source_errata.handling: 3800 names the actual Kochergin, specified Arnold and Chaika-Wright branches; 381C states the explicit single-singularity roof model and q_(n+1)<=C q_n log^2 q_n condition, not every Diophantine frequency or every mixing surface flow.

source_errata.status: LUS3 has K_epsilon versus K_delta and M versus M_s notation slips; k=0 gives an empty effective-shear family.
source_errata.handling: 3819 consistently uses M=M_s, m<=floor(delta^-1), k>=1 and integer ell with ell delta<M. The three substantive conditions are retained.

source_errata.status: Pullback growth written |t|^sigma for all real t vanishes at t=0.
source_errata.handling: 381J uses (1+|t|)^sigma, the standard all-time normalization, retaining polynomial growth as a genuine hypothesis.

source_errata.status: The displayed 3-epsilon proof tacitly suppresses mass of g(D) outside E.
source_errata.handling: 3818 proves a safe 5-epsilon bound directly from Definition 3.1 without adding containment; records 3 epsilon when g(D) is contained in E.

source_errata.handling: 3806/3808/380N distinguish observable-wise degenerate Gaussians, centered constants/coboundaries, and existence of at least one positive-variance observable.
